title: The ALMA-PILS survey: Stringent limits on small amines and nitrogen-oxides towards IRAS 16293-2422B
question: Are NH2OH, CH3NH2 and their potential precursors NO, N2O and CH2NH present towards the low-mass protostar IRAS 16293B, and what do their abundances imply for formation routes?

what.value: Reference column densities NH2CHO=1e16, CH3OH=1e19, H2>1.2e25 cm-2 at B offset position
Abundance ratios in Sgr B2, Orion KL and hot core models for comparison

external_data.citation: (cite: Belloche2013; Turner1991; Halfen2013; Neill2014; Garrod2013; Crockett2014)

recipe.goal: Fit LTE synthetic spectra to detected species
recipe.method: Grid of LTE models fitted to lines at one-beam offset position, chi2 minimisation plus by-eye acceptance
key_parameters: CH2NH: N=1e14-5e15 cm-2, Tex=25-300 K; NO and N2O: N=1e15-1e17, Tex=25-400 K; Vpeak 2.5-2.9 km/s; FWHM=1 km/s
assumptions: LTE, source size 0.5", Tbg=21 K due to dust

recipe.goal: Derive 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections
recipe.method: 1 sigma = 1.1*sqrt(dv*FWHM)*RMS on strongest transitions in line-free ranges, converted to N versus Tex
key_parameters: Tex=100 K for quoted limits; 3 sigma 23 mJy km/s (CH3NH2), 27/21/27 (NH2OH)

recipe.goal: Confirm N2O with TIMASSS and estimate emitting size
recipe.method: Gaussian fits and rotation diagram of four unblended TIMASSS lines; compare line fluxes to get emitting area

recipe.goal: Compute abundance ratios and compare with Sgr B2, Orion KL and models
recipe.method: Ratios to NH2CHO, CH3OH and H2 compared with literature

answer_key.quantity: N(NH2OH) 3 sigma upper limit at 100 K

evidence.quote: upper limit column density of NH$_{2}$OH of $\leq$3.7$\times$10$^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ at $T_{\rm ex}$ = 100 K

answer_key.quantity: N(CH3NH2) 3 sigma upper limit at 100 K

evidence.quote: the upper limit column density is $\leq$5.3$\times$10$^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$

answer_key.quantity: N2O Tex and N from TIMASSS

evidence.quote: The best fit to the optically thin lines in the TIMASSS data is found for $T_{\rm ex}$ = 68 K and $N$ = 1.7$\times$10$^{16}$ cm$^{-2}$

not_stated_but_needed: Calibration and imaging details (CASA version, weighting, continuum subtraction) are only in the PILS paper
Exact grid step sizes and chi2 definition for the LTE fits
Line-free ranges used for RMS of upper limits
Adopted source size treatment for N2O in the PILS fit and the T_bg derivation
TIMASSS line list and rotation diagram details
score_reason: Public data and clear LTE recipe, but PILS reduction is in other papers and fits are partly by eye.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple LTE fit and upper-limit recipe with numeric results, though dependent on PILS cubes.
